title: SOUTHWEST AIRLINES DECLARES 191st QUARTERLY DIVIDEND
summary: DALLAS, Nov. 12, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Southwest Airlines Co. (NYSE: LUV) Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend…...
body_markdown:
DALLAS


, Nov. 12, 2026


/PRNewswire/ --[Southwest Airlines Co.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4819398-1&h=1685853272&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.southwest.com%2F%3FSRC%3DIRPRDVDANN261112&a=Southwest+Airlines+Co.) (NYSE: LUV) Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $.18 per share to Shareholders of record at the close of business on December 17, 2026, on all shares then issued and outstanding. The quarterly dividend will be paid on January 7, 2027.
